packs.name: Species Unknown
packs.author: ai
packs.notes: Species Unknown (Unreal Engine 5). Solo play only. Infinite health locks health at 100 (not yet tested against a real hit; the health bar may only redraw after a hit or heal). Infinite ammo locks the gun in hand at 15 bullets (pistol magazine size). Faster movement sets walk speed once (normal is 170); set it again after a new mission if needed. Money is written into the progress save, so it stays once the game saves.
